$comment: Coverage of the core library and the template app, the template's summarize golden-set score, and recall@3 of the RAG module on its example corpus. All run on deterministic stand-ins (the fake model, the hashing embedder), so they need no key.

gates.name: coverage
gates.cmd: node tools/py.mjs -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider core/tests template/backend/tests --cov=ai_app_chassis --cov=app --cov-report=term --cov-report=json:.harness/quality/coverage.json

gates.name: eval-retrieval
gates.cmd: node tools/py.mjs -m ai_app_chassis.rag_eval --docs core/evals/retrieval/docs --golden core/evals/retrieval/golden.jsonl --out core/evals/results/retrieval.json --k 3
